original: 天気悪いし、給料日前だし、今日は出かけるのやめとくわ。

en.text: The weather is bad, and I haven't gotten my paycheck yet. I think I'll give going out a pass today.

original: 彼らは昼前に連絡します。

en.text: They will contact us before midday today.

original: 家に帰る途中、郵便局の前を通るよ。

en.text: I'll pass by the post office on my way home.

original: 何もかも十年前と同じだ。

en.text: Just about everything is the same as with 10 years before.
Just about everything is the same as 10 years before.

original: 分け前が欲しいな。

en.text: I want my part of the money.

original: 彼女は二年前に肉食をやめた。

en.text: She stopped eating meat two years ago.

original: トムと私は三ヶ月前に初めて会った。

en.text: Tom and I first met three months ago.

original: 群馬県の県庁所在地は前橋市です。

en.text: Gunma Prefecture's capital is Maebashi City.

original: 前も同じこと聞いたような気がする。

en.text: I think I've heard this before.
I have the feeling that I've heard that. before.

original: 行く前に電話します。

en.text: I'll call him before I go.

original: 前言撤回するよ。

en.text: I'll take back what I said.

original: 毎朝八時前に家を出ます。

en.text: Each morning I leave the house before eight.

original: 俺の気が変わる前に、行け。

en.text: Go, before I change my mind.

original: 前払いでお願いします。

en.text: You need to pay in advance.

original: 食べる前には手を洗った方がいいよ。

en.text: Before eating anything, you should wash your hands.
You should wash your hands before eating.

original: 今も3年前と同じ体重です。

en.text: I'm still the same weight I was three years ago.

original: お店が閉まる前に行っといで。

en.text: Go to the store before it closes.

original: 食品を扱う前は手を洗うこと。

en.text: Wash your hands before you handle the food.

original: 大型で非常に強い台風が接近中です。風が強くなる前に避難が必要な方は避難してください。

en.text: A very large and powerful typhoon is now approaching. If you need to evacuate, please do so before the winds get stronger.

original: 一週間前に歯を抜きました。

en.text: I had a tooth pulled a week ago.

original: 毎晩寝る前に本を読みます。

en.text: I read a book every night before bed.

original: 前に会ったことがあるような気がする。

en.text: I feel like I've seen him before.

original: 朝飯前だよ。

en.text: It's as easy as can be.
It's a piece of cake.

original: 食べる前にひと工夫！

en.text: Before eating here's a small tip.
Before eating here is a little advice.

original: 口に出す前に考えろ。

en.text: Think first before you speak.
Think before you speak.
